'''Kijio Mnuue''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]], who worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
For over a century, Mnuue worked at [[Tallaani Shipyards]] and over that time held various jobs, working as a hull welder, a loadlifter foreman, a cargo inspector and department manager. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he worked as the director of the yards' "Department of Environmental Maintenance". He formed the [[Guild of Non-Human Skilled Laborers]], to oppose the way that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was trying to get [[Alien/Legends|alien]] workers out of the labor pool at the yards, which resulted in him regularly being tailed by Imperial agents. Mnuue also joined a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] cell and gathered information for the Alliance through his contacts at the yard, and also from other contacts in the [[Corellian Shipbuilders Union]] and the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] community.<ref name="CRO" />

==Personality and traits==
Mnuue was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] who had an even temperament and a calm demeanor. He was a strong leader and worked tirelessly to protect the livelihood of the non-humans working at the shipyard. He had a slow, careful way of speaking that made him appear slow-witted but was actually quite intelligent.<ref name="CRO" />

==Skills and abilities==
Due to his diverse career Mnuue was skilled in almost all areas of the shipyard from [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] repair to managing and leading teams of workers. He was naturally very strong and had could work for hours without rest.<ref name="CRO" />

==Equipment==
Mnuue carried a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a badge of office, and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kijo Mnuue was designed by [[Paul Sudlow]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].
